name: speakai-mcp
description: Capture meetings, search thousands of recordings, run async voice and video surveys, create clips, and automate workflows with Speak AI. 184 MCP tools, 5 resources, 3 prompts, and 8 skills.

interface.longDescription:
Speak AI transcribes and analyzes your interviews, sales calls, research sessions, webinars, podcasts, and team meetings. This connector brings that library into your AI assistant, so instead of scrubbing hours of audio, you just ask.

Capture: Send a meeting assistant to Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, or Webex. Upload audio, video, or text. Run async voice and video surveys with custom questions.

Analyze: Search and reason across thousands of recordings at once with citations. Chat with your library, save favorite prompts, and keep a full history. Pull decisions, action items, owners, risks, sentiment, themes, and exact quotes.

Act: Create clips, highlights, captions, notes, folders, fields, and embeds from chat. Chain steps with automations and webhooks: auto-tag new recordings, route insights to other tools, or run a custom prompt against every new upload.

Share and organize: Export answers, transcripts, captions, and clips. Generate embed links and shareable views. Bulk move media, update transcripts and speakers, and clone setups across teams.

Who it's for: researchers, revenue and customer-success teams, meeting-heavy operators, and media and content workflows: anyone who records conversations and wants to stop re-listening to find what matters.

Your recordings stay in your Speak AI workspace. The connector only queries them with the permissions you allow.

Limitations: the connector works only with recordings in the Speak AI workspace you connect. Deleting, overwriting, and anything that sends data outside Speak AI are marked so your assistant can check with you before running them.
defaultPrompt: Summarize this week's meetings into decisions and action items.
Find customer quotes about onboarding, with the source recordings.
Clip the best 30 seconds of the latest webinar and export captions.

review.commerce_description: Speak AI does not sell products or process payments through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Tool safety annotations now follow OpenAI's published guidance. Tools that overwrite, cancel, change access, or send data outside Speak AI are marked destructive, and tools that reach public pages or arbitrary URLs are marked open-world. The hosted server no longer exposes local file upload. Adds an onboarding skill, listing icons, support and terms links, and skills that defer to the user's explicit instructions.
